title: Generic instructional lexicon (Layer 3)
description: Publisher-agnostic instructional marker strings -> Layer-2 instructional-profile roles. The fallback lexicon consulted AFTER a source-specific lexicon (e.g. openstax) so a non-OpenStax textbook still resolves its practice prompts. Matching is case-insensitive PREFIX on the block's leading text.
$comment: Marker set lifted from align_gold.py PRACTICE_MARKER_LEXICON['generic']. These are cross-publisher guided-practice openers; a new publisher is onboarded by adding a row here (or a new source lexicon), never a code edit. Roles reference genre_profile_instructional.json.

lexicon.precedence: consulted after any source-specific instructional lexicon
